name: base_utils
description: Manages shared host utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and a Hiera-defined list of utility packages, with supporting health-check and restart operations.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Builds and deploys the Python application stack, including PostgreSQL configuration, systemd service management, monitoring, log rotation, backups, and health checks.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures and manages an HAProxy load balancer with generated backends, optional node discovery, firewall rules, statistics, logging, TLS, and service ordering.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL using repository and version-specific package management, then manages the PostgreSQL service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis cluster nodes with tunable port, password, memory, and eviction settings, using PuppetDB-based discovery for cluster membership.

name: profile
description: Provides thin site profiles for base operating-system services and composition of the application stack, HAProxy, and Redis cluster modules.

name: role
description: Defines node roles that assemble base, application, load-balancer, and cache profiles for different server topologies.
